searches_run: WebSearch: Rahm Emanuel 2011 Chicago mayor campaign website
page_evidence: Team Rahm is our campaign's official grassroots fundraising group, made up of people from all over Chicago who want to see Rahm Emanuel as our city's next mayor.
note: Web search reported that Emanuel announced his run in a video on ChicagoforRahm.com. The CDX count of 932 is for host chicagoforrahm.com with HTTP 200 from 2010-02-22 to 2011-02-22, limit 5000. Pages show footer 'Paid for by Chicago for Rahm Emanuel'. The domain rahmemanuel.com has 3 in-window captures (first 20101211100037); I did not read them, and chicagoforrahm.com is the accepted site.

searches_run: WebSearch: Paul Vallas 2023 Chicago mayor campaign website
page_evidence: Paul Vallas for Mayor of Chicago (page title); site description: 'Paul Vallas has a long history of successful and innovative crisis management both in his hometown Chicago'; menu 'Join Team Vallas'.
note: Web search reported paulvallas2023.com as the campaign site. The CDX count of 815 is for host paulvallas2023.com with HTTP 200 from 2022-04-04 to 2023-04-04, limit 2000. The window ends on the runoff date; the 2023-02-28 first-round date is inside it. paulvallas.com returned no in-window 200 captures. The lead URLs come from search result lists; I did not open them. Some Wayback requests from mac2 failed transiently and were retried.
